values.note: 2026 (City of Evart): non-river sites $30 a night, $40 weekend or holiday; river sites (4-8) $35 / $45; weekly $180 / $210; seasonal $1,300 / $1,500 (no tents; $300 / $500 non-refundable deposit). One rate for everyone (no resident discount posted). Booked on Campspot, the park adds 3% of the site charge as a campground fee and Campspot its own booking fee (3%, at least $3). Riverside East primitive tent sites $15.

fees.source: https://www.evart.org/our_community/riverside_park_campground.php ('Riverside West Campground 2026 Season': River Sites (sites 4-8) Daily $35, Weekend $45, Holiday (3 day min.) $45, Weekly $210, Seasonal (No Tents) $1,500; Non-River Sites Daily $30, Weekend $40, Holiday $40, Weekly $180, Seasonal $1,300; Riverside East Tents Daily $15), read 2026-10-25 + https://www.campspot.com/park/riverside-park-campground-evart-m (price breakdowns '30 Amp Non-River Sites: $30.00 x 1 night | Campground Fees $0.90 | Booking Fee $3.00', read 2026-10-13, audit/price_research/campspot_recheck_2026-10-13.jsonl)

values.note: Reservations for the new season open January 1, on Campspot or through Evart City Hall (231-734-2181). Full refund less a $25 fee with 14 days' notice. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am. Seasonal sites are also sold. Neither Campspot front end listed any site type in late October 2026 (between seasons).

booking.source: https://www.evart.org/our_community/riverside_park_campground.php ('The City of Evart Campgrounds will start taking reservations for the new season January 1st.'; 'Holiday (3 day min.)'; 'TO MAKE A CAMPGROUND RESERVATION PLEASE CLICK HERE' -> campspot.com/park/riverside-park-campground-evart-m; 'contact Evart City Hall at' -> campspot.com/book/riverside-park-campground; refund and check-in lines) + https://www.campspot.com/book/riverside-park-campground (park 3947 'Riverside Park Campground - Evart, MI'; availability empty for 2026-10-27 and 2027-06-15), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Non-campers pay $5 for a shower and $10 for the dump station. The Riverside East bathrooms and showers are locked at night unless campers are present (vandalism).

values.note: 16 RV sites at Riverside West sold on Campspot (11 non-river, 5 river sites 4-8); site 3 is the camp host's. Riverside East across the river has 15 primitive tent-only sites (no RVs). No length limit posted.

summary: City page (2026 rates) + Campspot: fees confirmed $30-45 (non-river $30 weekday to river $45 weekend/holiday; flat rate, no resident discount posted), season May 1 - Sept 30 (confirmed, derived -> manual), reservable on Campspot (url set to the /book/ link the city page carries), 3-night holiday minimum, showers and dump; sites changed 15 -> 16 RV sites (11 non-river + 5 river; host site 3 not sold; 15 tent-only sites at Riverside East). Seasonal sites are offered at both RV types but every RV site is also sold nightly, so it is not long-stay in character. 30-amp and water left as derived (city page silent; Campspot listed no types between seasons, so the rig type could not be checked). Note left as is.
